authority_citations: REQ-SAG-0201 v2 (locked): Every Rust type that maps to a field of the TypeSafe Jev API (POST /v1/systemone, GET /v1/models) must be defined in the sc-decision-schema crate. Scope: adds or changes a type that maps to a TypeSafe API field.
phase-a-intent v1: define sc-decision-schema with the decision trait; every TypeSafe API request and response sent through sc-agent with minimum code

item.title: Fixture pass
item.text: sc-decision-llm imports SystemOneRequest and SystemOneResponse from sc-decision-schema and defines no Jev-shaped type of its own.

cases.rationale: Locked pass fixture of REQ-SAG-0201: Jev API types come from sc-decision-schema and no other crate defines one.

item.title: Fixture fail
item.text: sc-decision-systemone defines its own JevAnswer struct mirroring the TypeSafe choice answer.

cases.rationale: Locked fail fixture: a Jev answer type defined outside sc-decision-schema breaks 'must be defined in the sc-decision-schema crate'.

item.title: Sprint A2: Jev schema types
item.text: Add the SystemOneRequest, SystemOneResponse, ChoiceAnswer and ModelInfo structs for POST /v1/systemone and GET /v1/models to the sc-decision-schema crate, generated from the TypeSafe API spec. sc-agent-http and sc-decision-llm depend on sc-decision-schema and use these types; they define no Jev API types themselves.

cases.rationale: The item places every Jev API type for both named endpoints in sc-decision-schema, exactly what REQ-SAG-0201 requires.

item.title: Sprint A3: Jev request serialization
item.text: Implement serde serialization for the Jev request and response sent to POST /v1/systemone, including the choice answer and confidence fields, and add round-trip tests against recorded TypeSafe responses.

cases.rationale: The item works on types that map to Jev API fields (in scope) but never says which crate defines them; REQ-SAG-0201's placement rule is absent, and silence is not a conflict.

item.title: Sprint A4: shared HTTP client
item.text: Build the shared HTTP client in sc-agent-http that sends Jev decision requests to POST /v1/systemone with retries and timeouts. Keep the Jev API types consistent and well documented.

cases.rationale: The item depends on Jev API types and mentions them generically, but does not state that they are defined in sc-decision-schema; nothing in it defines a type elsewhere, so no conflict.

item.title: Sprint A5: self-contained HTTP layer
item.text: In sc-agent-http, define private SystemOneRequest and ModelsResponse structs for the Jev endpoints so the HTTP layer has no dependency on sc-decision-schema.

cases.rationale: Jev API types defined in sc-agent-http instead of sc-decision-schema directly break REQ-SAG-0201.

item.title: Sprint A6: log rotation
item.text: Add daily rotation and gzip compression of session log files in the sc-agent logging module, with a configurable retention of 30 days.

cases.rationale: Log-file rotation adds or changes no type that maps to a TypeSafe API field, so the item is outside REQ-SAG-0201's scope.

item.title: Sprint A7: batch progress
item.text: In sc-decision-runner, add a BatchProgress struct that counts completed, pending and failed decisions for the progress display. It is internal to the runner and is never serialized to or from any TypeSafe API endpoint.

cases.rationale: REQ-SAG-0201 governs only Rust types that map to a field of the TypeSafe Jev API; a new type outside sc-decision-schema that maps to no API field is outside its scope.

item.title: Sprint A8: response field update
item.text: Add the new `reasoning` field that POST /v1/systemone now returns to the SystemOneResponse struct in sc-decision-schema, and update the crates that read the response to use it.

cases.rationale: Changing a Jev API type is in scope ('adds or changes a type that maps to a TypeSafe API field'); the change stays in sc-decision-schema, as REQ-SAG-0201 requires.

item.title: Sprint A9: early Luna backend
item.text: As a temporary shortcut until sc-decision-schema is ready, sc-decision-llm defines its own SystemOneResponse struct for POST /v1/systemone; it will be moved into sc-decision-schema in a later sprint.

cases.rationale: REQ-SAG-0201 says 'Every' Jev API type and states no temporary or staged exception; a self-declared temporary definition outside sc-decision-schema still breaks it.
